Ruling: representation; project retained; model value dropped from the fixture. In this case the Part II screen (f5695.part2_any) is No, so Schedule 3 line 5b is $0, yet the generated return carries window costs, so the project's line 32 is $600 (agreed). The model subtracted that $600 on worksheet line 2; the project subtracts Schedule 3 line 5b, the credit taken on the return: i5695 p. 5, Residential Clean Energy Credit Limit Worksheet—Line 14, line 2, "Enter the total of the following credit(s)/adjustment(s) if you are taking the credit(s)/adjustment(s) on your 2025 income tax return" and "Note: Enter the total of the preceding credit(s)/adjustment(s) only if allowed and taken on your 2025 income tax return". Part I is not completed here either (f5695.part1_any No, line 13 $0), so line 15 and Schedule 3 line 5a are $0 on both sides (agreed). The hand predictions, where Part II is completed, put line 32 on worksheet line 2 as the project does (none has both parts).
